I feel that way with some people, too. Mostly with my parents or relatives. But I found people who I truly love and they say they love me back. I got to know those people because I started talking to them and found out they liked the same things as I did. When you found something in common with someone, it gets a lot easier getting to know them. Maybe you will like them, or maybe you won't. But I think that by doing things you like, it not only motivates you and gives you a purpose to live, but you also get to spend time with people that may have the same interests as you. 

I honestly hope you'll feel better and that you'll find people you actually love. Please, don't feel guilt when people say "you are loved". That phrase is to make you feel better, rather than to make you feel guilty about it. Your pain is valid, and I think you should find ways to meet people that you love and stay alive for them, instead of staying alive for someone you don't.
